verdict.line: You lose if you eat Riposte on your all-in or stack her Vitals procs; you win if you bait her cooldowns and hit a clean double-E combo.

brief.thesis: This matchup is decided by two cooldowns: Fiora's W (Riposte) and your second cast of E (Hookshot). If Riposte is up when you commit your dash, she parries it, shields, and slows you into a losing trade; if it's down, your combo goes through clean. The 50.6% win rate over 409 games reflects a lane where neither kit has a structural edge — it's entirely about who baits first.

theirWindow.when: Riposte (W) is up, you dash first
theirWindow.what: She parries your second Hookshot or your R cast, gets a shield plus a slow on you, and flips the trade — never throw the second E or engage your ultimate into an up Riposte.

yourWindow.when: She just used or whiffed Riposte (W)
yourWindow.what: Riposte has one of the longest cooldowns in her kit relative to how often she needs it — the moment it's down, close with auto, Q (Precision Protocol), then commit the second E dash and full combo before it comes back up.

powerCurve.note: Her Q poke punishes early all-ins
Her ult reveals vitals, heals hard

start.why: 60.1% pick rate and the higher win rate of the two common starts (50% over 286 games) — the extra sustain and AD let you win the level 1-2 trades where Fiora's poke is otherwise ahead.

boots.why: 83% pick rate at 50.4% win — Fiora's damage is almost entirely auto-attack based (empowered Bladework hits), so flat reduction on those hits matters more than magic resist.

core.why: Your first spike — the movement speed and bonus damage proc let you actually catch her after a Riposte whiff instead of eating a kite.
Sustain and AoE let you win extended skirmishes once her Vitals healing stops outpacing your own regen.
Highest-sample third item in the core path (98 games, 49%) — the damage-over-time conversion blunts her true-damage Vitals bursts specifically.

situational.when: she's landing Vitals procs consistently and you need burst-damage mitigation over sustain (57.9% win rate over 38 games in this slot)
the lane is going long and even, since this path posts a 78.1% win rate over 32 games as a scaling pick
she starts Ignite or you expect heavier level 1-3 poke than a standard lane
her ultimate's sustain is winning extended fights and you need the grievous wounds to shut it down

runes.keystoneWhy: Highest pick rate at 23.4% (45.5% win) — the proc-and-heal on your first trade auto directly counters her Vitals sustain by giving you your own damage-and-heal loop in short trades.

summoners.why: Flash+Ignite is the dominant pick at 72.7% (49.9% win) and gives you the kill pressure to punish a Riposte whiff before she can walk away; if you expect a longer, scaling lane, Teleport+Ignite posts the highest win rate of the three loadouts (56% over 16% pick).

playing.title: Never dash into an up Riposte
playing.detail: Check her W cooldown before committing the second Hookshot cast or your ultimate — walking her Riposte on cooldown first with autos and Q turns your all-in from a coinflip into a guaranteed hit.

playing.title: Track her Vitals stack location
playing.detail: Her passive marks a spot on your body after enough hits from one direction — vary your positioning in trades so she can't cash in the true-damage-and-heal proc for free.

playing.title: Trade on your Q auto-reset, not hers
playing.detail: Precision Protocol's empowered auto is your highest-damage single trade tool — take it before she gets her third empowered Bladework auto off, then disengage before the wave pushes.

playing.title: Respect the level 6 spike
playing.detail: Her ultimate reveals every Vitals point in an area and heals her off each proc — avoid extended all-ins right as she hits 6 unless you already have a clear cooldown advantage.

playing.title: Time your ult around her Q, not her flash
playing.detail: Hextech Ultimatum traps her in a zone she can't Flash out of, but she can still Lunge (Q) to reposition inside it — bait that dash out before you commit fully to the duel.

playing.title: Hydra spike changes your trade math
playing.detail: Once Ravenous Hydra completes, your sustained damage in extended fights outpaces her Vitals healing — start initiating longer trades instead of poke-and-reset.

playing.title: Don't fight through her Riposte parry
playing.detail: If she successfully parries any ability, immediately disengage rather than continuing to trade — the shield and slow flip the fight in her favor for the next several seconds.

brief.patchCaveat: Build paths, runes, summoners, and all win-rate figures are measured from live OP.GG games on the current patch (16.18.1); the mechanical reasoning, timings, and trade patterns are my own tactical read of the kits.

stats.opponentTip: Be careful of being hit with Fiora’s Vitals (P) often! Try to avoid being hit with Riposte (W) by not using the second Hookshot [E] immediately. Aim for when Riposte (W) is on cooldown!
